NFL Radio Fandom by County — 2026 Season

Dominant NFL radio affiliate at each U.S. county seat, based on daytime Longley–Rice (FM) and AM groundwave coverage from the RadioLand database. Hover a county for its winning station. Pick a team to see every affiliate in its network plotted on the map.
